ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominance of low-intensity black pixels (estimated >90%) with localized high-intensity yellow-white clusters at the distal margins and fine white speckling at the median base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast contiguous yellowish-white clusters mapping to the distal tips of both lobes. Discrete white punctate mottling distributed sparsely across the central dark field, with higher density near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 65 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing boundary exhibiting irregular micro-serrations with increased amplitude (jaggedness) at the distal extremities coinciding with accretion sites.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep originating from the median notch and curving upward and outward toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white/yellow pixels at the distal tips and inner trailing margins, indicative of concentrated biological attachment points.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological accretion and secondary scarring concentrated at the lateral tips of both fluke lobes, characterized by yellowish-white mineralized texture.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellow chromaticity within the high-intensity distal clusters, distinct from standard white pigmentation.
